start.title: [TODO:tr] Who Is My Neighbor?
start.text:
[TODO:tr] Jesus sits on the hillside.
"Let me tell you a story."

walk_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Turn Back
walk_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Some stories find you anyway.
Return and listen.

rule_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Listen First
rule_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Love is not a rule to memorize.
It is a road to walk.

attack.title: [TODO:tr] Down to Jericho
attack.text:
[TODO:tr] A man walked the lonely road.
Robbers left him beaten, alone.

pity_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] See Him
pity_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Compassion must open its eyes.
Look at him fully.

priest.title: [TODO:tr] A Priest Passes By
priest.text:
[TODO:tr] A priest walked the same road.
He saw the man, then crossed over.

cheer_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Not Yet
cheer_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Holy clothes did not soften him.
Mercy is the holier robe.

excuse_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] No Excuse
excuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Love makes time it does not have.
Feel the wound.

levite.title: [TODO:tr] A Levite Passes By
levite.text:
[TODO:tr] Then a Levite came near.
He looked, then walked away too.

hope_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Be the Neighbor
hope_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] The world waits for someone.
Let that someone be you.

samaritan.title: [TODO:tr] A Samaritan Stops
samaritan.text:
[TODO:tr] A Samaritan saw the broken man.
He knelt down beside him.

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] No Borders
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] He is the neighbor you did not expect.
Receive his goodness.

tend.title: [TODO:tr] Oil and Wine
tend.text:
[TODO:tr] He cleansed the wounds with care.
He bound them with his own cloth.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Rush him: it takes too long

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] You learn what love looks like.

rush_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Be Patient
rush_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Healing cannot be hurried.
Stay near him.

lookaway_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Stay With Him
lookaway_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Mercy does not turn away.
It stays through the hard part.

inn.title: [TODO:tr] Bring Him to Shelter
inn.text:
[TODO:tr] He lifted the man onto his donkey.
He carried him to a quiet inn.

leave_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Finish the Mercy
leave_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Half-finished kindness still wounds.
See him fully settled.

pay.title: [TODO:tr] Two Silver Coins
pay.text:
[TODO:tr] "Care for him. I will return
and repay whatever it costs."

minimum_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Go Further
minimum_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Love does not count its coins.
It covers what is needed.

ending.title: [TODO:tr] Go and Do Likewise
ending.text:
[TODO:tr] Jesus looks straight at you.
"Go now. Do the same."
